details.publicNotes:
Quietuses arise from the souls of those who delight in oppressing art and speech, especially when it criticizes them or opposes their beliefs and goals. Their tyranny in life manifests in their new demonic forms as a zone that silences everyone else nearby. Though quietuses can technically communicate telepathically, they seldom choose to, as they enjoy forcing others to endure the grating sound of their voices. Whatever the topic of conversation, quietuses are utterly convinced that their perspective is correct, and they use a combination of threats, lies, magic, and sheer stubbornness always to have the last word.

When a quietus arrives in a settlement, it seeks out centers of expressive speech and performance, such as town halls, temples, amphitheaters, libraries, and museums, and utterly destroys them. While the demon's schemes often begin with cultural centers, they indiscriminately wreck buildings, commit murder, and cause havoc until little is left but silent rubble.

Noise Demons

On rare occasions, quietuses can arise from the souls of jealous and controlling musicians. Instead of casting a field of silence, these demons overpower all other sounds with their music, creating the same effect. Such quietuses are sometimes called noise demons, and they believe their music to be above all other forms of art.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 250/560/1,030 gp

description.value: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

You induce deafening and nauseating vibrations throughout the bodies of all creatures in the area, dealing 5d10 sonic damage with a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and is deafened for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}, and is deafened for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Your competitiveness drives you to prove yourself against the opposition. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks. If an enemy within 20 feet critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check, your status bonus increases to +3 for attack rolls or that specific skill check (whichever the foe critically succeeded at) for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.iJ7TVW5tDnZG9DG8]{Spell Effect: Competitive Edge}

Heightened (7th) Increase the base bonus to +2 and the increased bonus after an enemy critically succeeds to +4.

Your enchanting performance draws everyone's attention to you, for good or for ill. Opponents have an easier time targeting you, gaining a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against you. However, the distraction makes it more difficult for them to defend themselves and perform more complex tasks. If you Sustain the spell, creatures attempt a new saving throw at the beginning of each of their turns.

@UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.038zIL01Uo5qBYUJ]{Spell Effect: Steal the Show}

You call in a favor from one demon of level 2 or lower, two demons of level 0 or lower, or three demons of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are eager to pursue the task, so they don't ask for a favor.

Success You conjure the demon or demons. They are not eager to pursue the task, so they require a favor in return.

Failure You don't conjure any demons.

Critical Failure The demon or demons are angry that you disturbed them. They appear before you, but they immediately attack you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of demon you call by 2 for each option.

description.value:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

The target makes no sound, preventing creatures from noticing it using hearing alone. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This prevents it from casting spells due to the magical words involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.mmJNE57hC7G3SPae]{Spell Effect: Silence}

Heightened (4th) The spell creates an aura in a 10-foot emanation around the touched creature, silencing all sound in or passing through it. While within the aura, creatures are subject to the same effects as the target. Depending upon the position of the effect, a creature might notice the lack of sound reaching it (blocking off the noise coming from a party, for example).

Trigger A creature affected by the quietus's silence spell successfully Strikes the quietus

Effect The quietus puts a finger to their lips and hisses loudly, assaulting the mind of whoever dared disturb their peace. The creature takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:32|basic] save).

A quietus can't bear to be in the presence of people sharing mirth through music, dance, or other forms of art. When a creature Performs for an ally who can hear them and their Performance check is higher than quietus's Will DC, the quietus takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage.

The quietus attempts to steal the voices of nearby creatures. All creatures within 30 feet take @Damage[5d8[mental]] damage and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save, after which they are temporarily immune to Steal Voices for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage. The creature can't speak or use effects with the concentrate trait for one round, during which time the quietus can speak using the creature's voice.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature can't speak or use effects with the concentrate trait for 3 rounds. During this time, the quietus can cast spells using the creature as the origin point.

The three mouths of the quietus whine in discordant harmony, making sure they are heard above all others. If the next action the quietus uses is to Cast a Spell with the auditory or sonic trait, creatures that fail their saving throw against the spell's effects also become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the start of the quietus's next turn. While deafened, they can still hear the quietus's voice.

A quietus's auditory abilities, speech, and spellcasting are unaffected by their own @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy] spell, including when speaking using another's voice by means of Steal Voices.
